### Cause

When nested blueprints are registered (`parent.register_blueprint(child)` followed by `app.register_blueprint(parent)`), `Blueprint.register` (`src/flask/sansio/blueprints.py:302-304`) builds the dotted registered name `f"{name_prefix}.{self_name}".lstrip(".")` (e.g. `"parent"` for the parent and `"parent.child"` for the child), and `Blueprint._merge_blueprint_funcs` (`src/flask/sansio/blueprints.py:379-411`) stores the blueprints' callbacks (`before_request_funcs`, `after_request_funcs`, `teardown_request_funcs`, `error_handler_spec`, `url_default_functions`, `url_value_preprocessors`, `template_context_processors`) on the app under those registered names (`"parent"`, `"parent.child"`, etc.).

During request handling, `Request.blueprints` (`src/flask/wrappers.py:181-196`) resolves the active blueprint hierarchy by calling `_split_blueprint_path(self.blueprint)` (`src/flask/helpers.py:645-651`). Those names are then used by:
- `Flask.preprocess_request` (`src/flask/app.py:1377-1391`) for `url_value_preprocessors` and `before_request_funcs`
- `App._find_error_handler` (`src/flask/sansio/app.py:865-888`) for `error_handler_spec`
- `Flask.update_template_context` (`src/flask/app.py:603-618`) for `template_context_processors`
- `Flask.process_response` (`src/flask/app.py:1410-1413`) and `Flask.do_teardown_request` (`src/flask/app.py:1442-1446`)
- `App.inject_url_defaults` (`src/flask/sansio/app.py:968-976`)

In `src/flask/helpers.py:649`, `_split_blueprint_path` stripped from the left instead of the right:
```python
out.extend(_split_blueprint_path(name.partition(".")[2]))
```
For `name = "parent.child"`, `name.partition(".")[2]` produced `"child"` instead of `"parent"`, returning `["parent.child", "child"]` instead of `["parent.child", "parent"]`. As a result, `"parent"` was never in `request.blueprints`, so parent blueprint handlers were skipped while child handlers (`"parent.child"`) and app-level handlers (`None`) still ran.

### Fix

Updated `_split_blueprint_path` in `src/flask/helpers.py:645-651` to split from the right with `rpartition(".")[0]`:
```python
@cache
def _split_blueprint_path(name: str) -> list[str]:
    out: list[str] = [name]

    if "." in name:
        out.extend(_split_blueprint_path(name.rpartition(".")[0]))

    return out
```
